editorial.meta_description: The UiPath Automation Developer Advanced exam is retired. Candidates should prepare for the UiPath-ADPv1 successor exam.
editorial.overview: The UiPath Automation Developer Advanced exam was a formal certification administered by UiPath. It covered advanced architecture, APIs, AI center, document understanding, performance, and governance across all enterprise workflows. This particular credential is retired as of 2023-10-13. Its verified replacement is UiPath-ADPv1, which all candidates must take instead to demonstrate their technical proficiency in modern automation development environments and enterprise-grade solutions.
editorial.who_should_take: Automation developers and technical professionals preparing for advanced UiPath certifications. Candidates should focus on the successor exam, UiPath-ADPv1, as this credential is no longer active and cannot be taken for credit.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Do not study for or attempt to sit this retired exam under any circumstances. Instead, direct all preparation efforts entirely toward the official successor UiPath-ADPv1. Core automation concepts transfer well, but candidates must align with the updated requirements of the current successor to ensure they meet the modern standards required for certification.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers advanced architecture and design patterns for complex automation deployments within the UiPath platform to ensure scalability and maintainability across enterprise environments for all developers seeking to build secure, long-term automation solutions.

This domain focuses on advanced orchestrator workflows and APIs, managing processes, queues, and robot fleets efficiently to maximize operational throughput and visibility across complex enterprise integration landscapes for developers managing large-scale automation deployments and infrastructure.

This domain deals with AI center and document understanding to process unstructured documents and data accurately using machine learning models within enterprise automations and intelligent document processing workflows for advanced automation developers.

This domain addresses performance optimization and troubleshooting for automation stability, solid error handling, and faster execution times across all deployed UiPath studio workflows and automated business operations to ensure high-quality, reliable enterprise-level automation results.

This domain encompasses security and governance to ensure safe, compliant, and well-controlled automation practices that adhere to enterprise auditing and credential management standards established by organizational policies for all secure automation development projects.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Because this exam is retired, it cannot be scheduled on exam day. Candidates must register for the successor exam, UiPath-ADPv1, which features a duration of 90 minutes and costs 250 dollars for all interested certification candidates.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consists of a total of 55 questions in a linear format featuring multiple choice, multiple select, and scenario-based question types for all candidates seeking to validate their advanced skills.

The passing score required to successfully pass the examination is set at 70, reflecting the high standards expected of advanced automation developers who are working within the UiPath ecosystem today.
The exam has a strict duration of 90 minutes, during which candidates must complete all assigned questions within the allotted timeframe provided by the official testing center and examination board.
